title: F3 skeptic: Caesar shift=5 alone, no other moving parts
hypothesis_summary: Skeptic-minimal counterpart to F3-31. Tests ONLY Caesar shift=5 as a single-layer cipher. The Stehle anomaly is a 9-letter local property; the skeptic reading refuses to compose it with other layers. If F3-31 outperforms this floor, the additional layers contributed; if not, the proponent reading is over-complex.
constraints: Single-layer Caesar only; no keywords; no other operations.
caveats: Caesar alone has been historically eliminated for K4 under direct correspondence — the pack exists primarily as a baseline-floor reference, not as a candidate.
